comments.author: @crayder1100
comments.text: I have to say. Everyone always judges MidJourney based on it's past and don't realize how much it has moved forward already. Like @4:30 when they say MidJ doesn't have a "reasoning brain"... literally, sure, but MidJ versions 5.0-5.2 are hugely focused on how it interprets your prompts' language. You can say things in English and it understands what to do. It also has an AI chat interpreter of it's own in it's Describe and Revise features. This is not to say DALL-E 3's interpretation isn't going to be way better, it definitely will be, it's just people always seem to have outdated knowledge of MidJ.
